problem.description: Buttons on articles page are not responding to clicks

issue.code: export let onclick: ((e: MouseEvent) => void) | undefined = undefined;
issue.description: Component has incorrect onclick prop instead of properly handling Svelte's on:click event

root_cause.conflict: The Button component expects an `onclick` prop (HTML attribute style) but the articles page is using `on:click` (Svelte event directive). The handleClick function checks for onclick prop (lines 56-58) but never receives it because parent components use on:click.

solution.approach: Remove the onclick prop and rely solely on Svelte's event dispatching system

steps.step: Remove the onclick prop from Button component
Remove the onclick handler check in handleClick function
Ensure event dispatch works correctly for all button clicks

issue.description: Fixed ALL button click events in articles page by replacing incorrect onclick HTML attributes with proper Svelte on:click event directives

testing_requirements.test: Verify Edit buttons open edit modal
Verify Delete buttons open delete confirmation
Verify form submission works in modals
